strings.איזה רגע מהעבודה יחד אני זוכר?: What moment from our work together do I remember?
strings.אין הוראות ERP לילד לבדו, אין ציון על פח: No child-alone ERP instructions, grades for fear or requirement to continue until distress disappears. The form sets no new treatment action. Encouragement for participation must not depend on a particular report.
strings.אין להחיל את המסלול על קבוצות גיל אחרות: Do not apply this pathway to other age groups without separate review.
strings.אין שמירה אוטומטית ואין שליחה לרשת. השתמ: Nothing is saved automatically or sent over the network. Use fictional information for review. If an answer does not fit, shorten it or save the complete answers as text and move them to a continuation page. Check print preview.
strings.בדקו למידה, השתתפות ובחירה גם כשנשאר קוש: Review learning, participation and choice even when difficulty remains. If unsuitable, the therapist reassesses; do not add attempts based on the sheet.
strings.בחרו בדף לאחר הערכה מקצועית ובהסכמה. אפש: Choose this sheet following professional assessment and with consent. The person may skip questions, answer aloud, or choose another tool. This is proposed original material for review; it provides no score, diagnosis, or promise of an outcome.
strings.גילי 6–7: לספר מה למדנו בליווי המטפל: Ages 6–7: sharing learning with therapist support
strings.דבר קטן שלמדתי עם עזרה: A small thing I learned with help
strings.דבר קטן שלמדתי עם עזרה | Mindful Path: A small thing I learned with help | Mindful Path
strings.דוגמה בדויה: אחרי עבודה עם המטפלת, דניאל: Fictional example: After therapist-supported work, Daniel describes asking for help. His mother describes how he asked without grading his feelings. The therapist explores learning and unclear points.
strings.דף P משותף לילד ולמלווה: שתי שאלות לקול: The P sheet is shared: two questions for the child's voice and three for supporter observations. Use only as agreed with the therapist, without child-alone exposure homework, abrupt response changes or punishment. Daily records and thought counts are unnecessary.
strings.המטפל או המלווה מקריא שאלה אחת. הילד יכו: The therapist or support person reads one question. The child may use a few words, point or skip. Adults may write the child's words but not answer for them. Professional terms and descriptions of every thought are not required.

Therapist guide: Ages 6–7: sharing learning with therapist support | Mindful Path
strings.הקישורים הבאים שימשו לרקע בלבד. השאלות ו: The following links were used for background only. Questions and adaptations were written afresh for the expansion plan; no questionnaire, scale, or protocol was copied. Adult sources do not validate the child versions. This material makes no claim about session count or treatment effectiveness.

strings.טיוטה לסקירת מנהל. סקירה קלינית ואישור ז: Draft for administrator review. Clinical review and final rights approval are still pending.
strings.ילד בגילי 6–7 ומלווה מתאים: Child aged 6–7 and a suitable support person
strings.ילד ומלווה יחד, לפי סיכום עם המטפל. שתי: Child and support person together, as agreed with the therapist. Two child questions and three supporter questions. Spoken answers are welcome.
strings.ילד ומלווה, עם המטפל: Child and support person, with therapist
strings.ילד יכול לזכור רק פרט קטן או לא לרצות לס: A child may remember only a small detail or not want to share. Do not extract reports through interrogation. Supporters can note observations and leave meaning for discussion.
strings.ילד, מלווה ומטפל — תפקידים נפרדים: Child, support person and therapist — separate roles
strings.יש תשובה שחורגת משטח המילוי. הטופס לא הו: An answer exceeds the writing area. Printing was stopped to prevent silent clipping. Return to the screen, shorten the answer or save the complete answers as text and move them to a continuation page. Your entered text has not been deleted.
strings.לילד: איזו עזרה היית רוצה בפעם הבאה?: Child: What help would you like next time?
strings.לילד: מה תרצה לספר על העבודה יחד?: Child: What would you like to tell about our work together?
strings.למלווה: כיצד הילד ביטא בחירה או קושי?: Support person: How did the child express choice or difficulty?
strings.למלווה: מה התאפשר מתוך מה שהמטפל קבע?: Support person: What was possible from the therapist's plan?
strings.למלווה: מה נביא לסקירה לפני החלטה על המש: Support person: What will we review before deciding next steps?
strings.לשיחה עם המטפל והמבוגר שמלווה אותי. אפשר: For talking with the therapist and my support adult. I can say a little, point or skip; the adult can write my words.
strings.לשמוע את חוויית הילד לאחר עבודה טיפולית: Hear the child's experience after already agreed, adapted treatment work and gather supporter observations for the therapist's learning review.
strings.מה אני רוצה לשאול עכשיו?: What do I want to ask now?
strings.מה חשבתי שיהיה לפני שהתחלנו?: What did I think would happen before we began?
strings.מה נביא לשיחה אחרי העבודה: What we will bring after the work

strings.מטפל המיומן ב־OCD בגילי 6–7: Therapist skilled in OCD care for ages 6–7
strings.מיפוי מול מדריך OCD מלא ואישור מקצועי עד: Mapping against a full OCD manual and professional approval remain pending. This is original support material for review, not an approved ERP manual or its replacement.
strings.מסלול OCDYC נפרד מגילי 8 ומעלה. אין להסי: OCDYC is separate from ages 8 and over. Shortening an adult form does not establish suitability. Earlier OCDYC learning may help, but unit 5 does not prescribe a session number.
strings.מתי רציתי עזרה או הסבר?: When did I want help or an explanation?
strings.סכמו מה הובן ומה נשאר פתוח. היעזרו ב־SES: Summarize what became clearer and what remains open. Use the existing SES-S01 and SES-S02 for the session framework. There is no need to repeat an assessment or plan already recorded.
strings.קול הילד בגילי 6–7: The voice of the child aged 6–7
strings.קיימת רשומת סקירה נפרדת לכל גרסה: התאמת: Each version has a separate review record covering age suitability, originality, rights, and fictional filling. Reviewer and date fields remain blank until assigned. File checks or a code merge are not clinical approval. Clinical information stays only in the authorized setting, outside the code repository.
strings.שאלה אחת מספיקה לפתיחת שיחה. אין צורך לד: One question can start a conversation. Distress ratings and explanations of adult concepts are unnecessary.
The learning question and framework are defined in treatment. Check whether follow-up recording suits the family and whether reassessment is needed.
strings.תארו התנהגות והקשר בלי לפרש שתיקה כהסכמה: Describe behavior and context without treating silence as consent or fear as failure. Keep observations separate from the child's voice.
strings.תפקיד ההורה או המלווה: The parent or support person's role
strings.תפקיד המטפל והתאמת המסגרת: The therapist's role and adapting the setting
